note: Area-own document only (frame:<app> for apps; page for shell/tv). spacing: occurrences (padding/margin/gap, non-zero) — share on 4 px grid, 8 px grid, and exactly on the --sp-* token set {4,8,12,16,20,24,32,40,48,64}; macro = values >= 8 px. margins: per device min/median/max of left and right; span = vw - left - right (median). radii: non-pill painted radii occurrences per profile kind, share on the kind's --r-* set. concentric: every child/parent corner pair the rig checked; bad = |r - want| > max(3, 25% R). shadows: computed box-shadows classified by their outer drop layers against this document's resolved --e1..--e4 (and local lift tokens): eN = exactly the token (glass insets and 0-blur rings allowed on top), eN+literal = token plus extra drop layers, literal = no token, ring-only / inset-only. targets: on-screen, not covered, enabled; adults/kiosk < 44, kids < 64 (the kid --tap).
